stem: Which sentence best expresses the author's main claim in the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: Flying cars that exist today are little more than expensive toys.

options.label: B
options.text: There is no longer a need for flying cars because the internet makes leaving your house unnecessary.

options.label: C
options.text: Flying cars will soon be widely promoted to make commuting easier.

options.label: D
options.text: There is ample justification for being disappointed that flying cars are not already widely available.
